items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: Well his daddy used to play with me. He was one of our best drummers.

ctx.x: When I first went to New Orleans I went to study music. That was your first time? Oh yeah. That was my first time in New Orleans. In 1909 I went to study music. And I was taking lessons from Mr. Moret on Ursuline Street. Which one? Eugene. That's the one who used to play with only white bands. Never played with colored bands. His brother is the one, George Moret, that's the one who used to have the excelsior band.
His wife is still alive, George's wife. That's what young Louis Cattrall told me, the clarinet play. Oh yes, I see. Well his daddy used to play with me.
He was one of our best drummers. He could read some music, let me tell you.
